def _run_work_with_retry(
    prompt: str,
    *,
    workspace: str,
    model: str,
    agent: str,
    bus_id: int,
    continue_session: bool = True,
) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    last_out = ""
    for attempt in range(1, AGENT_MAX_RETRIES + 1):
        rc, out = _run_agent(
            prompt,
            workspace=workspace,
            model=model,
            continue_session=continue_session,
        )
        last_out = out or last_out
        if rc == 0:
            log.info("[cursor-exec] done bus#%s rc=0 attempt=%s", bus_id, attempt)
            return True, last_out
        log.warning("[cursor-exec] bus#%s attempt=%s rc=%s", bus_id, attempt, rc)
        if attempt < AGENT_MAX_RETRIES:
            backoff = AGENT_RETRY_BACKOFF[min(attempt - 1, len(AGENT_RETRY_BACKOFF) - 1)]
            time.sleep(backoff)
    if bus_id > 0:
        _mirror_exec_failed(agent, bus_id, AGENT_MAX_RETRIES)
    return False, last_out


def _notify_owner_tg(text: str) -> bool:
    """把结果直发主人 TG 私聊（私聊# 看不见回复的补洞）。"""
    script = (
        Path.home()
        / "Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/scripts/_tg_notify_owner.py"
    )
    body = (text or "").strip()
    if not body:
        body = "(无文本输出)"
    # 取末尾，避免超长刷屏；保留结论
    if len(body) > 3200:
        body = "…\n" + body[-3000:]
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(script), body],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=30,
        )
        ok = proc.returncode == 0 and "ok" in (proc.stdout or "")
        if not ok:
            log.warning(
                "[cursor-exec] tg notify fail rc=%s out=%s err=%s",
                proc.returncode,
                (proc.stdout or "")[:200],
                (proc.stderr or "")[:200],
            )
        return ok
    except Exception:
        log.exception("[cursor-exec] tg notify exception")
        return False

        )
        # 私聊结果必须回 TG（11-23：wake 路径以前只停对话里，主人看不见）
        summary = (out or "").strip()
        if not summary:
            summary = f"{label} 已执行，但无文本输出（ok={success}）"
        prefix = f"【{label}】" if label else ""
        _notify_owner_tg(prefix + summary)
        log.info("[cursor-exec] TG_DM label=%s ok=%s notified=1", label, success)
        return success
    except Exception:
        log.exception("[cursor-exec] TG_DM label=%s failed", label)
        try:
            _notify_owner_tg(f"【{label}】自动执行失败，请在 Cursor 里看或重发。")
        except Exception:
            pass
        return False
